text:
marc: Heads up — we're planning to apply the `add column country_code` DDL + backfill in the quiet window at 00:00-02:00 UTC. Schedule starts in ~30m. Please read the runbook snippet below before approving.

deploybot: [deploybot] migration queued: id=2026-06-15-cc-add, ops-run=cron-quiet-window-1. Preflight checks running. To approve: `/deploy approve 2026-06-15-cc-add`

emily: Quick notes: backfill will run with rate_limit=500 rows/s and safemode=true (skip long-running UPDATEs). We'll do a canary on 5% of tenants first.

raj: I'll watch locks/replica lag during the canary. If any long locks appear I'll flag immediately. Oncall contact: @oncall.

thalia: Service compatibility: pin reader-service to v2.14.1 for the 1h window after migration. Consumers should be compatible but we need to avoid older clients hitting the new nullable column validations.

marc: Rollback criteria (agreed):
- >1% 5xx from API for >5 minutes
- replication lag > 60s for >10 minutes
- any permanent lock > 5s on main write path affecting >3 requests/s
If any of the above, we stop the backfill and run rollback steps.

emily: Rollback command (preflighted):
```
-- run on primary only
SELECT run_migration_rollback('2026-06-15-cc-add');
```
Expect ~2-5m to revert schema change, backfill stop may be async.

deploybot: Preflight complete: schema validation OK, foreign key checks OK. Holdpoint: canary ready. Run `/deploy continue 2026-06-15-cc-add --canary=5%` to start.

marc: Approved. `/deploy continue 2026-06-15-cc-add --canary=5%`

deploybot: Starting canary: targeting 5% tenant set. Canary start ts=1779001300. Will report health every 60s.

emily: Canary running. Backfill progress: 12k rows processed (~220s elapsed), no lock spikes so far.

raj: Observability: charts show lock_wait p50=30ms, p95=420ms for a single shard (watching). Replication lag stable at ~8s. If p95 crosses 1s for >2 consecutive intervals we pause.

marc: Canary health good from my side. No errors in logs. Proceed to 50% after 10m stable.

deploybot: Canary succeeded. Advancing to 50% at ts=1779001600.

thalia: Reminder: pin reader-service on k8s via RollingUpdate pause — I'll patch the deployment to v2.14.1 now.

oncall: Monitoring after 50% advance. I'll escalate to infra if any cross-shard lock cascades show up.

emily: Backfill throttle adjusted to 700 rows/s for secondary-heavy shards. Running post-change smoke checks for consumers.

marc: Final checks passed. Full rollout beginning. Note for release notes: mention nullable column, backfill, no client changes required, potential slight tail latency increase for ~30m.

deploybot: Full rollout complete at ts=1779001900. migration_id=2026-06-15-cc-add status=success.

raj: Post-rollout watch for 30m starting now. If anything problematic, follow rollback steps and @marc/emily on escalation.

thalia: Release notes updated and published.

marc: Great work. Filing a short postmortem with perf numbers and any anomalous shards in #postmortems tomorrow. :tada:
